dedupe_keys.name: synthetic ifc benchmark for rail ifc quality gating r3 r7 v1 0 2

description: Juan García and colleagues at Alicante University publish a synthetic IFC benchmark for rail-asset information quality checks. Version 1.0.2, dated July 2026, includes IFC files, case manifests, injected-fault descriptions, expected outcomes and threshold profiles under CC BY 4.0. Cases test coordinate regimes, scale mismatches, TrueNorth outliers, inter-model anchor dispersion, proxy overuse and missing property-set information. These files can verify that a model-preparation pipeline detects errors before infrastructure geometry enters a digital-twin simulation. The suite is synthetic and does not represent a real depot or operational asset. Real-project performance and the full range of IFC failure modes remain unknown. A separate G6 record describes the companion quality-gate software; no existing catalogue record explicitly covers this benchmark. The archive was not downloaded or passed through an IFC checker.
